profile.headline: Full Stack Engineer | Ruby on Rails | AI Agent Orchestration
profile.summary:
I’m a full stack software engineer at FEFA with a background in financial services and filmmaking. I enjoy building useful tools and finding resourceful ways to solve problems.
At FEFA, my work includes rebuilding team communications as a PWA, automating paperwork to reduce completion time by 75%, creating a tvOS leaderboard, and building private LLM environments on local infrastructure and AWS EC2.
I also built a personal AI orchestration app connecting Campfire, local models, and an LLM gateway. It routes work to architect, worker, and reviewer models, requires my approval of model choices and estimated costs, and executes YAML plans in parallel through a deterministic bridge. An adversarial reviewer checks the work before delivery with its completion cost. I access it from my phone through Tailscale. I’ve also taken two iOS apps through TestFlight, working with Apple’s development and distribution process.
Across work and personal projects, my toolkit includes Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, Vue, SQL, Twilio, Cloudflare, Docker, Kamal, DigitalOcean, OpenAI Codex, and Ollama.
I hold CompTIA Security+ and am an Associate of ISC2.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Rebuilt team communications following Twilio Frontline’s discontinuation, delivering a familiar interface and PWA that supported the team’s compliance requirements
• Built automated paperwork tools that reduced completion time by 75%
• Created a tvOS leaderboard app giving office and remote employees a shared view throughout the workday
• Built the business’s initial private LLM environment and an AWS EC2 deployment

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Work within a team executing full stack development using a JavaScript Stack.
Write and maintain clear, secure, extensible, and scalable code within a JavaScript stack
Conduct development tasks and tests
Design and implement REST APIs

positions.title: Web Development Student
positions.description:
Development Project: Dad’s Fantasy (Football) App: personally built a web app that presents the user with a dashboard covering news relevant to fantasy sports. The app is powered by a filtered Twitter feed, using the Twitter API 2.0, allowing the user to be updated on fantasy news in real-time directly from the source's Twitter account. The app also provides leading news articles through a News API and Rotoworld’s RSS feed. The database is PostgreSQL with frameworks Ruby on Rails, Vue.js, and Bootstrap.


Bootcamp: Learned fundamentals and best practices in full-stack web development in areas of project architecture, backend, frontend, and how to effectively self-teach new technologies
Generated technical requirements and determined the most effective solutions, created wireframes, designed schema, and researched outside resources
Built and tested the backend, incorporating external APIs
Created pages and RESTful routes, made web requests to retrieve data, formatted and styled results, incorporated libraries and themes

positions.title: Financial Advisor
positions.description:
Improved the user experience when interacting with the company CRM by leading a team in User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
Installed and created workflow for the life insurance segment of the business. 
Produced webinars and broadcasting from headquarters, expanding the company's footprint during COVID 19. 
Prospected a book of business of over $6m in assets in two years. 
Trained and managed a team of 6, increasing annuity sales by 6 million year over year.

positions.title: Content Producer
positions.locationName: City of Johannesburg, Gauteng, South Africa
positions.description:
Increased episode production for web series by creating and implementing a shooting format that is still applied today.
Edited a reality television show broadcast on national television.
Established an intern path between the university and the promoter, providing work opportunities for two more students during my time there.

positions.title: Server
positions.description:
Ensured patron satisfaction for general and exclusive events, including conducting wine tastings and serving VIP guests
Promoted to lead section assignments after six months.

positions.title: Diamond Department Manager
positions.description:
Demonstrated sales capability that led to management fast track after 90 days.
Drove the diamond department to achieve a 100K weekend goal over Mother's Day weekend.

educations.schoolName: City Varsity School of Media and Arts
